regime_context: Canada TSX: Detector shows Big Banks as narrative leader (eligible, full breadth, durability 0.72, crowded). Rotation is broad but no handoff; momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha. The absolute-trend gate has historically cut drawdown, so eligibility provides risk control.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Banks lead the narrative with strong durability and broad participation; the absolute trend gate supports eligibility, suggesting lower drawdown risk. Crowding (z=1.2) is a sizing caution, not a fade. Overweight contingent on trend persistence.
theses.dissent: Crowding could precipitate a sharp reversal if macro conditions (e.g., credit event) shift against banks; rank momentum offers no forward edge.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO loses trend-gate eligibility (e.g., closes below its 200-day moving average) within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Despite eligibility, very narrow breadth (0.111) and low durability (0.47) suggest the uptrend is fragile and vulnerable to whipsaw. Underweight to de-risk, not a fade call.
theses.dissent: Base metals could surge on China stimulus or supply disruption, overcoming low breadth.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO breadth rises above 0.5 and durability_bar exceeds 0.6 within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Ineligible per absolute-trend gate, the only validated risk-control edge. Avoiding reduces drawdown risk.
theses.dissent: Silver could stage a sharp rally on a geopolitical or monetary shock, making avoidance a missed opportunity.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO gains trend-gate eligibility (i.e., the underlying theme becomes eligible) within 30 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
